chunks: Dawud ibn Kathir ibn Abi Khalid, al-Raqqi, client of the Banu Asad. Narrates from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).
He was corrupt in madhhab. Weak in narration. He is not regarded.
ai.seo_question: Who is Dawud ibn Kathir al-Raqqi and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical entry describes Dawud ibn Kathir al-Raqqi, a narrator from the Imams, specifically noting his status as weak in narration and corrupt in creed, leading to his being disregarded in hadith transmission.
